releaseNotes: AURA 3.9.2 is a focused Auto-Mix diagnostic beta. Copied AURA Link senders receive distinct identities, Stem Mapping shows sender audio age, frames received, and short identity, and Auto-Mix distinguishes a healthy-but-silent sender from stale sender audio, a missing REF, an unsafe REF, and active measurement. Recommendation safety uses current-window peaks instead of the historical display hold. Double-click the Mix Score to open Deep Field. This build is intended to verify the remaining Ableton signal-path behavior before broader refinement.
